catches: Never spend extra solely to chase the $300 bonus; only use the card for purchases you would make anyway.
Annual fee is $0 per Truist's official compare table, so the full $300 bonus is net of any card annual fee.

If you carry a balance, interest (0% intro APR on purchases for 9 months, then 15.74% - 24.74% variable) can erase the bonus; pay in full each month.
Only new business cardholders qualify for the welcome bonus; existing/previous account terms may exclude you - check eligibility when you apply.
